jei.manaessencebridge.birthday_cake.1: The Birthday Mana Cake is a gift for the mod author's birthday. Every player gets one a year just by joining the game on October 17th. It cannot be crafted.
jei.manaessencebridge.birthday_cake.2: Place it in the same chunk as a mana pool, or a neighbouring one, and dig in: the cake has 7 slices. Each slice pours 72 000 mana into the nearest pool, and what does not fit goes on to the next one. Like any cake, it can only be eaten when you are hungry.
jei.manaessencebridge.birthday_cake.3: Each slice gives Regeneration II, Absorption II, Haste II and Luck - and eating several slices in a row adds their time together. It is more filling than an ordinary cake, too.
jei.manaessencebridge.birthday_cake.4: And a treat you cannot get anywhere else - Birthday Cheer. For 10 minutes, Botania tools and items spend half as much mana: the Rod of the Terra Firma, Terra Shatterer, mana-powered armour and the like. It stacks with the discount from Botania armour, up to 90%% in total. And every second it slips 500 mana into your mana rings and tablets - up to 300,000 over the ten minutes.
manaessencebridge.page.brookbell_p1: The $(item)Brookbell$(0) is a generating flower for any farm that moves its harvest by water - sugar cane, cactus, kelp, mob drops.
manaessencebridge.page.brookbell_p2: It takes nothing: every item drifting past in flowing water within three blocks gives a little mana once, then floats on to your chest.$(br2)Still water does not count - the items have to be moving.$(br2)It makes no more than 20 mana a second, so a dropper loop throwing the same items back into the stream is no better than an honest farm.
manaessencebridge.page.bumblebloom_p1: Bees take the $(item)Bumblebloom$(0) for an ordinary flower. Each time a bee gathers its nectar, the flower makes 400 mana.
manaessencebridge.page.bumblebloom_p2: After that it rests for 40 seconds: bees still visit it, but no mana comes until it is ready. A swarm does not help much - better several flowers around a hive.
manaessencebridge.page.condensation_lens: Put a $(item)Condensation Lens$(0) into a $(item)Mana Spreader$(0) aimed at an upgraded pool, and its bursts stop filling the pool: their mana turns straight into $(item)Inferium$(0), at the same buy-back price as the Essence Condenser.

A burst carries far less than an essence costs - about 16 ordinary bursts make one - so the pool keeps the change until there is enough. The essence goes into a container touching the pool, or lands on top of it.
A spreader never fires at a full pool, so the lens unclogs it: when it finds the pool full, it takes out one essence worth of mana and turns it into Inferium as well. Inferium crafts upward for free.
manaessencebridge.page.cross_recipes_p1: A few $(thing)Mystical Agriculture$(0) materials can be made with Botania tools as well. None of them makes tier essence - that still comes only from crops and pools.
manaessencebridge.page.cross_recipes_p2: Nether quartz soaked in a mana pool turns into a $(item)Prosperity Shard$(0).
manaessencebridge.page.cross_recipes_p3: With an $(item)Alchemy Catalyst$(0) under the pool, bone meal becomes $(item)Fertilized Essence$(0).
manaessencebridge.page.essence_condenser: The other half of the bridge for automation. The Essence Condenser takes mana from an upgraded pool at the usual buy-back price and turns it into essence on its own.

$(item)Right-click it with an essence$(0) to choose what it makes - the essence is not used up. Whatever it holds floats above it. Finished essence is pushed into any chest, hopper or pipe touching it; an empty-handed right-click hands it over and shows how the condenser is set up.

It works with a pool touching it, or with one up to 12 blocks away bound by the $(item)Wand of the Forest$(0): switch the wand to Bind Mode, $(item)Shift + right-click$(0) the condenser, then $(item)Shift + right-click$(0) the pool.

A plain $(item)right-click with the wand$(0) - or $(item)Shift + right-click$(0) with an empty hand - sets a reserve: 0, 25, 50 or 75 percent of the pool stays untouched, and at 90 percent it works on surplus only - while the pool is nearly full. A redstone signal pauses it.
manaessencebridge.page.essence_farm_p1: A farm that runs itself, built from things already in your pack. Around a patch of $(thing)Mystical Agriculture$(0) crops, plant a $(item)Mysticarnation$(0) to speed them up and a $(item)Reaperbloom$(0) to harvest and replant them.
manaessencebridge.page.essence_farm_p2: All that is left is to gather what drops - and that needs no new block.$(br2)The $(item)Hopperhock$(0) picks up items around it and puts them into an adjacent inventory. An upgraded pool counts as one: put the Hopperhock next to it, and essence goes in while mana comes out.
manaessencebridge.page.essence_farm_p3: Mind the balance: the flowers spend more mana than the essence they grow is worth. The farm saves time and gathers essence for you; it is not a source of free mana.$(br2)An $(item)Essence Condenser$(0) by the same pool turns that mana back into the tier of essence you actually need.
manaessencebridge.page.essence_siphon_p1: An upgraded pool can draw essence out of the containers touching it - chests, barrels, drawers, pipe buffers - on its own, no hopper needed. It is $(item)off by default$(0): $(item)right-click$(0) the pool with the Essence Siphon to switch it on or off.
manaessencebridge.page.essence_siphon_p2: A $(item)redstone signal$(0) on the pool pauses it, the same way it locks a hopper.$(br2)Not consumed. The pool takes only the tiers it can handle, and stops when it is full.
manaessencebridge.page.essentide_p1: The $(item)Essentide$(0) is a generating flower for $(thing)Mystical Agriculture$(0) farms. It eats resource essences - iron, diamond and the like - thrown within two blocks of it or drifting past in water, and sends the mana to a nearby $(item)Mana Spreader$(0).
manaessencebridge.page.essentide_p2: The higher the crop tier, the more mana: with default settings, from 200 for a first-tier essence up to 3200 for a fifth, and 6400 for a sixth-tier crop from Mystical Agradditions. Tier essences such as inferium are left alone - those go into a pool.
manaessencebridge.page.essentide_p3: Each essence takes a while to digest before the next one. Growing crops with a Mysticarnation always costs more than the Essentide gives back for them.
manaessencebridge.page.mana_ledger_p1: The $(item)Mana Ledger$(0) keeps track of every upgraded pool you own - the ones where you placed the first catalyst. $(item)Right-click$(0) it to list them in chat: where each one stands, its tier, mana, turnover and whether auto-pull is on.
manaessencebridge.page.mana_ledger_p2: Pools in unloaded chunks are shown as they were last seen.
manaessencebridge.page.melodia_p1: The $(item)Melodia$(0) listens to note blocks within four blocks of it. Every new note gives it mana, but the same note over and over gives less and less, down to nothing.
manaessencebridge.page.melodia_p2: It loves variety: a tune with many different notes earns a bonus, and so does a chord - different notes played at the same moment.$(br2)It makes no more than 30 mana a second, so it rewards a real tune on redstone, not a clock hammering one note.
manaessencebridge.page.mysticarnation_p1: The $(item)Mysticarnation$(0) is an Agricarnation for $(thing)Mystical Agriculture$(0): it draws mana from a nearby pool and speeds up the magical crops in a 7x7 area around it.
manaessencebridge.page.mysticarnation_p2: Mana is only spent on a stage that actually grew. Growing a crop this way always costs more mana than its essence is worth - it saves time, not mana. No more than $(item)three$(0) of them can speed up the same crop; any more simply stand idle.
manaessencebridge.page.overview_p1: A catalyst applied to a $(item)Mana Pool$(0) teaches it to convert $(item)Inferium Essence$(0) into mana and back.
manaessencebridge.page.overview_p2: Right-click with essence for one, $(item)Shift+Right-click$(0) for the whole stack. $(item)Shift+Right-click$(0) with an empty hand buys essence back.$(br2)An upgraded pool also accepts essence from hoppers and pipes.
manaessencebridge.page.reaperbloom_p1: The $(item)Reaperbloom$(0) harvests ripe $(thing)Mystical Agriculture$(0) crops in a 11x11 area and plants them again, one seed from the harvest going back into the ground. The rest drops beside the crop, ready for a hopper or a $(item)Hopperhock$(0).
manaessencebridge.page.reaperbloom_p2: One crop a second, for a little mana each. Together with the Mysticarnation it runs an essence farm on its own.
manaessencebridge.page.resonance_crystal: Put a catalyst on the wrong pool, or rebuilt the base? The crystal strips the $(item)top tier$(0) and hands the catalyst back intact.$(br2)$(item)Shift + right-click$(0) an upgraded pool. Sneaking is required: the action cannot be undone.
The price is mana from the pool itself - the same as buying one essence of that tier.$(br2)Not consumed. A pool can be taken apart all the way down, one tier at a time.
manaessencebridge.page.wardenia_p1: The $(item)Wardenia$(0) guards a farm in a 9x9 area.
manaessencebridge.page.wardenia_p2: It keeps farmland moist, so no water is needed nearby, stops players and mobs alike from trampling it, and pushes hostile mobs off its patch without hurting them, and stops their arrows, tridents, fireballs and potions before they land.
manaessencebridge.page.wardenia_p3: It also snuffs out explosions in a twice larger 17x17 area - creepers, TNT, ghast fireballs - and shields that area from blasts next to it. A floating Wardenia guards 16 blocks down - hang it over a house or a farm.$(br2)Any farmland works, not only $(thing)Mystical Agriculture$(0)'s. Mana goes only on actual work: a drop per moistened block, a little more per push.
advancements.manaessencebridge.tier_6_in: Open Insanium conversion for a pool
manaessencebridge.page.insanium0: A sixth tier, for those who have done everything else - and only with $(thing)Mystical Agradditions$(0) installed. The catalyst is made on the $(item)Runic Altar$(0), and only after defeating the $(thing)Gaia Guardian II$(0).
manaessencebridge.page.insanium1: A tier-6 pool holds 32 times as much mana as a plain one, and one Insanium essence is worth over two million mana.
manaessencebridge.page.insanium2: Upgrades a tier-5 pool to tier 6.
tooltip.manaessencebridge.boltbloom: Makes a burst of mana from every lightning strike nearby, and calls lightning itself in a thunderstorm
manaessencebridge.page.boltbloom0: The $(item)Boltbloom$(0) catches lightning. Every strike within eight blocks of it - from a storm, a lightning rod or a Channeling trident - gives a burst of 4000 mana.
manaessencebridge.page.boltbloom1: In a thunderstorm, with open sky above, it calls lightning down onto itself about once a minute. That lightning is harmless: no fire, no damage.$(br2)Rain alone gives it nothing, and after a strike it rests for five seconds.

manaessencebridge.page.essence_farm_mb: Crops all around, three flowers in the middle, a Hopperhock and a pool to one side. No water needed.

manaessencebridge.page.essence_mirror_p1: The $(item)Essence Mirror$(0) is a pool in your pocket. $(item)Right-click$(0) an upgraded pool to bind it. Then, anywhere in that dimension, $(item)right-click$(0) opens the pool: its mana, prices and any essence to buy. $(item)Shift + right-click$(0) sends all your essence in.
manaessencebridge.page.essence_mirror_p2: Prices are the pool's own, and a private pool still sells only to its owner. A pool in an unloaded chunk wakes up for the moment of the trade.$(br2)A bound mirror shimmers. Click another pool to bind it there instead.
manaessencebridge.page.expander_crystal_: An $(item)Expander Crystal$(0) placed against an upgraded pool makes it bigger: each one adds a quarter of the pool's capacity at its tier. Crystals touching such a crystal count too, so they can grow into a structure around the pool - up to 8 per pool.

The crystal stores nothing itself. Breaking it never loses mana: if the pool holds more than its new size, it only shrinks as that mana is spent.$(br2)Crystals do nothing for a pool without a catalyst.
manaessencebridge.page.expander_crystal1: It glows softly, like the pool it serves.

manaessencebridge.page.advanced_essence_: The same three flowers - $(item)Mysticarnation$(0), $(item)Wardenia$(0) and $(item)Reaperbloom$(0) - but floating. Hung one block above the crops they take no room, so the whole 9x9 field is crops: 81 instead of 21.$(br2)A floating flower is the flower plus any floating flower.
Six floating flowers and a floating Hopperhock over a 9x9 field, a chest on top, a pool beside it.

The $(item)Wardenia$(0) in the middle keeps all 81 blocks of farmland moist and guards them from trampling, mobs and explosions - the pool beside the field too.$(br2)Each $(item)Mysticarnation$(0) reaches 7x7, so every crop gets one to three of them; three is the limit anyway.

The $(item)Reaperbloom$(0) covers 11x11 and harvests the whole field. The floating $(item)Hopperhock$(0) gathers the drops and puts them into the chest above it.$(br2)Every flower must be within 10 blocks of the pool - feed it with a spreader. No soil is needed, so the farm can hang in the air or sit under glass.

manaessencebridge.page.mana_fertilizer_p: Drop $(item)Fertilized Essence$(0) into a Mana Pool and it soaks up 45,000 mana, becoming $(item)Mana Fertilizer$(0).$(br2)$(item)Right-click$(0) a $(thing)Mystical Agriculture$(0) crop with it, and every crop in the 3x3 around grows two stages. A dispenser facing the field does the same.

It works on Mystical Agriculture crops only.$(br2)Mind the price: a full-grown field of nine takes four of them - more mana than the crops' essence is worth. Like the Mysticarnation, it buys time, not free mana.
manaessencebridge.page.mana_fertilizer1: Any Mana Pool, no catalyst needed.

A dispenser takes it too.$(br2)It costs 440,000 mana in all - as much per crop as growing it any other way.

advancements.manaessencebridge.pool_netw: Link two Mana Pools with an Essence Mirror
manaessencebridge.page.pool_network_p1: Upgraded pools can share their mana. Bind an $(item)Essence Mirror$(0) to one pool, then $(item)Shift + right-click$(0) another with it: the two are linked. Once a second, mana flows from the fuller pool to the emptier one until both are equally full - however far apart they are.
manaessencebridge.page.pool_network_p2: Both pools must be loaded and in one dimension; a redstone signal on either pauses the link. Each pool takes up to eight links, so they can grow into a whole network. Click again to unlink; Shift + right-click the mirror's own pool to list its links.$(br2)With private pools on, share yours with $(item)/manabridge trust add$(0).

manaessencebridge.page.wardenia_belt_p1: The $(item)Wardenia Belt$(0) carries a Wardenia's guard with you. Worn in the $(thing)belt$(0) slot, it snuffs out projectiles that hostile mobs shoot within 4 blocks, pushes hostile mobs closer than 2 blocks away and defuses their explosions within 6 blocks: creepers, ghast fireballs. Bosses are too heavy to push.
manaessencebridge.page.wardenia_belt_p2: Your own TNT still goes off. Farmland under your feet never gets trampled.$(br2)Each action takes mana from $(item)mana rings$(0) and $(item)tablets$(0) in your inventory, at the Wardenia's prices. Out of mana, the belt just rests.
manaessencebridge.page.wardenia_belt1: Two Wardenias woven into a belt.
